speaker: Doctor
text: The positive amphetamine screen explains the aggression and autonomic symptoms, but I need to rule out rhabdomyolysis given the prolonged gym session. REQUEST TEST: Creatine Kinase, Urinalysis

speaker: Doctor
text: With rhabdomyolysis ruled out and a positive amphetamine screen, the clinical picture is consistent with amphetamine intoxication. I will monitor his vital signs and provide supportive care as the substance metabolizes. DIAGNOSIS READY: Amphetamine Intoxication
